dialogues.speaker: Kumar
dialogues.text: Thanks, but there's no need to worry. My condition is quite stable now.

dialogues.speaker: Kumar
dialogues.text: If I just continue resting as usual, then even if I can't train and hunt as my brother hopes, my condition shouldn't be too bad.

dialogues.speaker: Kumar
dialogues.text: My only regret... is probably that I can't go to the city and experience the Sabzeruz Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Kumar
dialogues.text: I heard the Akademiya isn't holding the Sabzeruz Festival as often as it used to. I may never get to attend one if that goes on...
